name: works.jobsweep/jobsweep
title: JobSweep
description: Search open jobs from career sites, ATS platforms and job boards. Free tier, no key needed.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search open jobs across all indexed career sites (duplicates merged). Use
        list_filter_values for valid filter values and get_job for a job's full description.

        Returns `jobs` (id, title, company, location, remote, employment_type, salary,
        posted_at, first_seen_at, url, company_url, apply_url) newest or most relevant first,
        `next_cursor` and `complete` (false: search in job descriptions ran out of time, results
        cover title and company matches only). For the next page repeat the call with the same
        filters and `cursor` set to `next_cursor`; null means the last page.

q.description: Full-text query in web search syntax: quoted phrases, OR, -exclude. Omit to list the newest jobs.
q.title: Q

location.description: Matches city, region or country text of the job location, e.g. `Berlin` or `Germany`.
location.title: Location

remote.description: Work mode; see list_filter_values for counts.

employment_type.description: Employment type; see list_filter_values for counts.

posted_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone; jobs posted or first seen after it.
posted_after.title: Posted After

limit.description: Jobs per page, 1-50 (1-25 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous call with the same filters.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_job
tools.description:
Get one job in full: plain-text description (truncated to 8000 characters), salary,
        every source posting it was merged from and their change history. Call after
        search_jobs with a job_id.

tools.name: list_filter_values
tools.description:
List the values accepted by the `remote` and `employment_type` filters of
        search_jobs with open job counts, plus top countries (ISO code, name) and companies.
        Call before search_jobs when you need valid filter values.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description:
Find companies by name with their number of open jobs, largest first. Pass a
        returned name as `company` to search_jobs to list that company's jobs.

limit.description: Maximum companies to return, 1-50 (1-25 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description:
Size and freshness of the index: open jobs, postings, career sites, live platforms,
        last successful crawl and recent crawl success rate. Not for finding jobs; use
        search_jobs.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description:
Which hiring platforms (ATS) are covered and whether they work: status (`live`,
        `blocked`, `no live deployments`, `no connector`, `no tenants`), career sites, open
        jobs and last successful crawl. `required` is true for platforms on the challenge list of 78
        and false for additional ones. Not for finding jobs; use search_jobs.

status.description: Only platforms with this status; omit for all platforms.
status.title: Status
